from pathlib import Path
import ast, importlib.util, re

path = Path('/work/textmask.py')
source = path.read_text()
compile(source, str(path), 'exec')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('textmask', path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

def original_masked(text, name):
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split('-')), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r'\b' + re.escape(tok) + r'\b', 'x', t)
    return t

cases = [
    ('Alpha alpha-beta beta ALPHA-BETA', 'alpha-beta'),
    ('go go-tool tool GO-TOOL', 'go-tool'),
    ('cat scatter cat-dog dog', 'cat-dog'),
    ('a.b aXb-a.b x', 'a.b-a.b'),
    ('Mixed mixed-case case MIXED-CASE', 'Mixed-Case'),
    ('foo foo foo', 'foo'),
    ('pre abc-def post; abc, def!', 'abc-def'),
    ('anything', ''),
]
for text, name in cases:
    actual = mod.masked(text, name)
    expected = original_masked(text, name)
    assert actual == expected, (text, name, expected, actual)

assert mod.name_tokens('ab-long-name-long') == sorted({'ab-long-name-long', 'ab', 'long', 'name'}, key=len, reverse=True)
assert [len(x) for x in mod.name_tokens('a-long-mid')] == sorted([len(x) for x in mod.name_tokens('a-long-mid')], reverse=True)
assert mod.masked('AN an tool TOOL', 'an-tool') == 'an an x x'  # 2-char part remains
assert mod.masked('Mixed mixed', 'Mixed') == 'mixed mixed'       # case-sensitive token matching preserved

assert len(body) == 3
assert isinstance(body[0], ast.Import) and [a.name for a in body[0].names] == ['re']
assert [n.name for n in body[1:] if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))] == ['name_tokens', 'masked']
masked_node = body[2]
assert any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id == 'name_tokens' for n in ast.walk(masked_node))
